For 034 (09/03/2018 DD/MM/YYYY), extraction appears to have swapped components or matched a different date token on the receipt (e.g., a time or secondary date), yielding 2018-08-09 instead of 2018-03-09."},{"cause":"Null return on hard-to-OCR receipts without multi-pass fallback","detail":"For 078, a single preprocessing + PSM 6 pass did not surface a usable total-keyword line. If 2+ of these companion values agree on a value V' that differs from V by exactly one digit substitution in a position where OCR commonly confuses characters (0↔O, 1↔7, 1↔l, 5↔S, 8↔B), replace V with V'. Note this as higher-cost but useful when accuracy is critical."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen Preprocessing for Receipts section with an additional recommended variant: Otsu/adaptive thresholding (binary) using a short Pillow snippet (grayscale → point threshold or ImageOps.posterize), to help when digits run together or faint ink causes '1' to be read as '7' or '.' to be lost."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit 'Null-safe output' checklist item reminding that when both date and total extraction fail even after multi-pass retry, the row must still be emitted with explicit Python None values and lexicographic filename ordering preserved — never raise or drop the row."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Clarify Common Pitfalls with concrete examples drawn from this class of task: show how 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' vs 'TOTAL: 23.25' should resolve to the post-rounding value, and how 'Total incl. of GST 702.00' with Subtotal 102.00 and Payment 102.00 should be auto-corrected to 102.00 via companion-line consensus."}],"confidence":"medium"}
